verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is a payments platform, and such a platform could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows third-party agents (Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) transacting through Adyen's protocols, plus an MCP server for use with the user's own external LLM client. Neither is a built-in assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to.
